commitResults.messageTitle: Add searches for student and guardian fields
commitResults.messageBody:
Find currently searches only student and guardian names and phones.
Other stored contact details and tags cannot be used to filter students.

Add email, address, tag and guardian relationship filters using the
existing case-insensitive matching rules. Cover parsing and filtering
with tests and document the supported prefixes.

Fix the existing Lesson Javadoc layout so Checkstyle passes.

Refs #84

commitResults.messageTitle: Add partial and complete lesson ID searches
commitResults.messageBody:
Find cannot currently list students by their enrolled lessons.
Tutors need both broad lesson searches and individual class rosters.

Add case-insensitive lesson ID filtering with exact matching for
five-component IDs and substring matching for shorter fragments.
Preserve OR within fields and AND across fields, and cover searches
with parser, predicate and command tests and user documentation.

Fix the existing Lesson Javadoc layout so Checkstyle passes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Prevent overflow in monthly payment searches
commitResults.messageBody:
Monthly totals use int even though valid payments and lesson fees can
exceed its aggregate limit. Overflow can misclassify payment status.

Use long for fee totals, payment totals and displayed balances. Add
regression tests for large paid and unpaid balances, and complete the
header comments in the payment-search changes.

Keep individual amounts unchanged to preserve the storage format.

Refs #92

The edit command now accepts gn/, gp/, ge/, gr/ and ga/. Guardian
fields can be edited individually; unspecified fields keep their
existing values. A student without a guardian (a legacy record) gets
one only when all five guardian fields are provided.

The edit command now accepts l/. Given lessons replace all of the
student's existing lessons, and an empty l/ clears them. Lessons are
also shown in the success message.
